notes: World-Space Local Token Clusters: fixes the remaining flat starburst effect in the Home 3D Local view. Co-located citizen and visitor presentation offsets now exist on the Local 3D ground plane before camera projection instead of being added afterward in screen pixels. The cluster therefore compresses, stretches, rotates, and scales naturally with camera orbit, tilt, and zoom while preserving one authoritative Simulation coordinate for each real shared point. v0.9.9 smooth authoritative route travel and perspective-scaled markers remain intact. The renderer performs no physical state writes.
